title.narrative: Program to modernize the regulatory framework for internationalization
Programa de Modernizacin del Marco Regulatorio para la Internacionalizacin

description.narrative: El objetivo general del programa es contribuir a la consolidacin del crecimiento econmico sostenible en Uruguay, a travs de un apoyo a las polticas de internacionalizacin. Los objetivos especficos son: (i) consolidar el marco normativo y las herramientas para fomentar la inversin y el comercio; y (ii) fortalecer los incentivos y condiciones a la innovacin para dicha internacionalizacin.

The general objective of the program is to contribute to the consolidation of sustainable economic growth in Uruguay, by supporting internationalization policies. The specific objectives are to: (i) consolidate the regulatory framework and tools to promote investment and trade; and (ii) strengthen the incentives and conditions for innovation for such internationalization.
Commitment in 2022-12-07
Disbursement in second quarter of 2023
